fixture_source: package-local HTML files; no network access

timing_definitions.navigation_duration_ms: Time spent navigating to the local fixture
timing_definitions.locator_lookup_duration_ms: Time spent locating and counting the expected role/name match
timing_definitions.action_completion_duration_ms: Time spent performing the action and waiting for its completion marker; not applicable when the locator does not match
timing_definitions.total_duration_ms: Elapsed time from before fixture resolution/navigation through task completion or failure; excludes browser launch and page cleanup

outcome_definitions.expected_success: True for baseline fixtures and False for defect fixtures
outcome_definitions.success: Whether the configured locator, action and completion marker all succeeded
outcome_definitions.outcome_match: Whether the observed task outcome matches the expected fixture outcome; null for infrastructure failures
outcome_definitions.failure_stage: Execution stage where a task failure occurred; blank when no task failure occurred
